features.feature_name: Repository mirroring from GitHub and Bitbucket
features.feature_summary: Cloud Source Repositories can mirror repositories from GitHub and Bitbucket through the beta user interface.
features.extended_definition: Cloud Source Repositories can mirror repositories from GitHub and Bitbucket through the beta user interface.

features.feature_summary: Cloud Source Repositories provides a beta user interface for managing repositories and related tasks.
features.extended_definition: Cloud Source Repositories provides a beta user interface for managing repositories and related tasks.

features.feature_summary: Cloud Source Repositories supports Pub/Sub notifications for repository events.
features.extended_definition: Cloud Source Repositories supports Pub/Sub notifications for repository events.

features.feature_name: Security key detection on code push
features.feature_summary: Cloud Source Repositories can detect security keys when code changes are pushed.
features.extended_definition: Cloud Source Repositories can detect security keys when code changes are pushed.

features.feature_summary: Cloud Source Repositories supports authenticating to repositories via SSH.
features.extended_definition: Cloud Source Repositories supports authenticating to repositories via SSH.
